faq.q: How can I place an order?
faq.a: Add the products you like to your cart and click the “Order via WhatsApp” button — your list will be sent to us as a ready-made message. You can also place an order by calling 055 426 24 39.
Yes. Nouvelle, Redist, RedOne and Razorline products come from official suppliers, and each has a serial number and production date. We do not sell counterfeit or expired products.

faq.q: How does delivery work and how long does it take?
faq.a: Orders within Baku are usually delivered the same day or the next day. Delivery in Baku is free for orders over 50 ₼; otherwise it costs 3 ₼. We ship to the regions by post or cargo within 2–4 business days.
We accept cash (on delivery), bank card and bank transfer. Note: discounts on scissors, razors and straighteners apply to cash payments only.

faq.q: How long are the discounts valid?
faq.a: Current promotions run until the end of the month or while stocks last. Razorline scissors are 40% off, RedOne products 20% off and the Artéko straightener 33% off. We announce new promotions on our Instagram page.

faq.q: Is there special pricing for salons and barbershops?
faq.a: Yes. We offer an extra discount on wholesale orders (for example, 12 hair colors, or a box of wax or cologne). Buy 8 combs and get a comb stand free. Message us for details.

faq.q: Which developer should I use with Nouvelle hair color?
faq.a: Nouvelle Hair Color is mixed at a 1:1 ratio. Choose 3% (10 vol) developer for tone-on-tone coloring, 6% (20 vol) for gray coverage and 1 level of lift, and 9–12% (30–40 vol) for 2–3 levels of lift.

faq.q: How long do Kera Sublime straightening results last?
faq.a: Kera Sublime is a semi-permanent smoothing cream. Depending on hair type and application technique, the result lasts several weeks and holds through dozens of washes. To prolong the result, use the Kera Sublime shampoo, mask and oil.

faq.q: Do you have scissors for left-handed users?
faq.a: Yes — the Razorline AK23L is made specifically for left-handed stylists. All Razorline scissors are made of stainless Japanese steel.

faq.q: Can I return or exchange a product?
faq.a: Unopened products with undamaged packaging can be exchanged or returned within 14 days. For hygiene reasons, opened cosmetic products cannot be returned; in case of a manufacturing defect, we replace them immediately.

faq.q: Which wax is right for my hair?
faq.a: For a glossy, “wet” look, choose Aqua waxes (Red, Blue, Cobra, Olive, etc.); for a natural matte finish, the Matte range (Green, Argan, Keratin, Matte White/Black); for texture and creative styles, Creative Fiber or Spider wax.

faq.q: Can I pick up products from the store myself?
faq.a: Of course. Confirm your order in advance via WhatsApp or by phone, and we will have it ready for you.
